title: Change text case
summary: COBOL: Change text case. Try your name. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: UPPER-CASE is a built-in function that makes letters uppercase.

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.

blocks.title: Change text case
blocks.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.

procedure division.
DISPLAY FUNCTION UPPER-CASE("asha")
stop run.

blocks.text: UPPER-CASE makes a new text result with capital letters.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Call this with FUNCTION before the function name.
